pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 13-unit (Join in the Fun!) grammatikasini takrorlaydi: infinitiv (to bilan / to siz) va -ing shakli.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 13-UNIT NAZARIYA (62-bet, PDF 61). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '13', sarlavha: 'The Infinitive - The -ing form'. Och pushti ramka, ikki ustun.

CHAP USTUN:
'The Infinitive': The infinitive is the base form of the verb. There are two kinds of infinitive: a) the to-infinitive (to go, to play) and b) the infinitive without to (go, play.) We use the to-infinitive: • after verbs such as decide, want, agree, begin etc. 'He wanted to buy some sugar.' • after the expressions would love, would like. 'I would like a sandwich.' We use the infinitive without to: • after the verb make a) 'The clown made the children laugh. (= cause somebody/something to do something)' b) 'My mother made me clean my room. (= force somebody to do something)' • after the verb let 'My father lets me use his computer.' • after modal verbs (can, could, will, would, etc) 'He can play tennis well.'
'The -ing form': The -ing form is the base form of the verb + -ing. 'fishing, watching' We use the -ing form: • usually after the verbs love, like, hate, enjoy etc. 'Tom likes playing basketball in his free time.' • after the expressions don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to. 'I don't mind going shopping.'

O'NG USTUN:
• We can use the to-infinitive or the -ing form after the verbs stop, remember and forget but there is a difference in meaning. Study the examples that follow. STOP: a) stop + to-infinitive = stop briefly to do something else 'I stopped to have a cup of coffee.' b) stop + -ing form = finish, give up 'We stopped reading when the bell rang.' REMEMBER: a) remember + to-infinitive = not forget 'Please remember to buy some milk.' b) remember + -ing form = bring to your mind 'I remember giving you the key before I left.' FORGET: a) forget + to-infinitive = not remember 'She forgot to pay the phone bill.' b) forget + -ing form = always remember 'I'll never forget learning how to ride a bicycle.'
JADVAL: to-infinitive: decide, want, would like, would love, begin, stop, remember, forget, refuse, agree, expect sb. infinitive without to: make, let, can, could, will, would, may, must. -ing form: love, like, hate, enjoy, stop, remember, forget, don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '62'.

exercises.instructionEn: The infinitive is the base form of the verb. There are two kinds of infinitive: a) the to-infinitive (to go, to play) and b) the infinitive without to (go, play). We use the to-infinitive after verbs such as decide, want, agree, begin etc: He wanted to buy some sugar; after the expressions would love, would like: I would like a sandwich. We use the infinitive without to after the verb make: The clown made the children laugh. (= cause somebody to do something) My mother made me clean my room. (= force somebody to do something); after the verb let: My father lets me use his computer; after modal verbs (can, could, will, would, etc): He can play tennis well.
exercises.instructionUz: Infinitiv - fe'lning asosiy shakli. Ikki xil: a) to-infinitiv (to go, to play) va b) to siz infinitiv (go, play). To-infinitiv decide, want, agree, begin kabi fe'llardan keyin: U shakar sotib olmoqchi edi; would love, would like iboralaridan keyin: Men sendvich xohlardim. To siz infinitiv 'make' fe'lidan keyin: Masxaraboz bolalarni kuldirdi. (= sabab bo'lmoq) Onam meni xonamni tozalashga majbur qildi. (= majburlamoq); 'let' fe'lidan keyin: Otam menga kompyuteridan foydalanishga ruxsat beradi; modal fe'llardan keyin (can, could, will, would): U tennisni yaxshi o'ynay oladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
INFINITIV - FE'LNING ASOSIY ShAKLI.

  IKKI XIL:
  a) TO-INFINITIV: to go, to play
  b) TO SIZ: go, play


TO-INFINITIV QAChON:

  1) decide, want, agree, begin,
     refuse, expect dan keyin:
     He wanted TO BUY some sugar.
  2) would like / would love:
     I would like TO HAVE a
     sandwich.


TO SIZ INFINITIV QAChON:

  1) MAKE + kim + fe'l:
     The clown MADE the children
     LAUGH. (kuldirdi)
     My mother MADE me CLEAN my
     room. (majbur qildi)
  2) LET + kim + fe'l:
     My father LETS me USE his
     computer. (ruxsat beradi)
  3) MODAL fe'llar:
     He CAN PLAY tennis well.

  ⚠ 'made me TO clean' ✗, 'can TO
  play' ✗ - to YO'Q!


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  to-infinitiv = '-moq' / '-ish':
  'sotib olmoqchi', 'ishlashni'.

points.en: He wanted to buy some sugar. I would like a sandwich. (to-infinitive after decide, want, agree, begin, would like, would love)
points.uz: U shakar sotib olmoqchi edi. Men sendvich xohlardim. (to-infinitiv)

points.en: The clown made the children laugh. My mother made me clean my room. (infinitive without to after make)
points.uz: Masxaraboz bolalarni kuldirdi. Onam meni xonamni tozalashga majbur qildi. (make + fe'l - to siz)

points.en: My father lets me use his computer. (after let)
points.uz: Otam menga kompyuteridan foydalanishga ruxsat beradi. (let + fe'l - to siz)

points.en: He can play tennis well. (after modal verbs)
points.uz: U tennisni yaxshi o'ynay oladi. (modal + fe'l - to siz)

exercises.instructionEn: The -ing form is the base form of the verb + -ing: fishing, watching. We use the -ing form usually after the verbs love, like, hate, enjoy etc: Tom likes playing basketball in his free time; after the expressions don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to: I don't mind going shopping.
exercises.instructionUz: -ing shakli - fe'lning asosiy shakli + -ing: fishing, watching. -ing shakli odatda love, like, hate, enjoy fe'llaridan keyin: Tom bo'sh vaqtida basketbol o'ynashni yoqtiradi; don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to iboralaridan keyin: Xaridga borishga qarshi emasman.
exercises.explanationUz:
-ING ShAKLI = FE'L + -ING
  (fishing, watching).

  QAChON:
  1) love, like, hate, enjoy:
     Tom LIKES PLAYING basketball.
  2) don't mind, couldn't help,
     can't stand, look forward to:
     I DON'T MIND GOING shopping.


⚠ 'DON'T MIND':

  = qarshi emasman.


⚠ 'COULDN'T HELP':

  = ... masdan turolmadim.


⚠ 'CAN'T STAND':

  = chiday olmayman.


⚠ 'LOOK FORWARD TO' + -ING:

  bu yerdagi 'to' - predlog, shuning
  uchun -ing: 'look forward to
  SEEING you'.

points.en: Tom likes playing basketball in his free time. (after love, like, hate, enjoy)
points.uz: Tom bo'sh vaqtida basketbol o'ynashni yoqtiradi. (love, like, hate, enjoy + -ing)

points.en: I don't mind going shopping. (after don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to)

exercises.instructionEn: We can use the to-infinitive or the -ing form after the verbs stop, remember and forget but there is a difference in meaning. STOP: stop + to-infinitive = stop briefly to do something else: I stopped to have a cup of coffee. stop + -ing form = finish, give up: We stopped reading when the bell rang. REMEMBER: remember + to-infinitive = not forget: Please remember to buy some milk. remember + -ing form = bring to your mind: I remember giving you the key before I left. FORGET: forget + to-infinitive = not remember: She forgot to pay the phone bill. forget + -ing form = always remember: I'll never forget learning how to ride a bicycle. Table: to-infinitive - decide, want, would like, would love, begin, stop, remember, forget, refuse, agree, expect sb; infinitive without to - make, let, can, could, will, would, may, must; -ing form - love, like, hate, enjoy, stop, remember, forget, don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to.
exercises.instructionUz: Stop, remember va forget fe'llaridan keyin to-infinitiv ham, -ing ham kelishi mumkin, lekin MA'NO FARQ QILADI. STOP: stop + to-infinitiv = boshqa ish qilish uchun to'xtamoq: Qahva ichish uchun to'xtadim. stop + -ing = tugatmoq, tashlamoq: Qo'ng'iroq chalinganda o'qishni to'xtatdik. REMEMBER: remember + to-infinitiv = unutmaslik (qilish kerak): Sut sotib olishni unutma. remember + -ing = eslamoq (qilganini): Ketishdan oldin senga kalit berganimni eslayman. FORGET: forget + to-infinitiv = unutmoq (qilmadi): U telefon to'lovini to'lashni unutdi. forget + -ing = hech qachon unutmaslik (qilganini): Velosiped haydashni o'rganganimni hech qachon unutmayman. Jadval: to-infinitiv - decide, want, would like, would love, begin, stop, remember, forget, refuse, agree, expect sb; to siz infinitiv - make, let, can, could, will, would, may, must; -ing - love, like, hate, enjoy, stop, remember, forget, don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to.
exercises.explanationUz:
STOP / REMEMBER / FORGET - IKKI
  MA'NO!

  STOP:
  + TO = boshqa ish uchun to'xtadi
    I stopped TO HAVE a coffee.
    (qahva ichgani to'xtadim)
  + -ING = tashladi, tugatdi
    We stopped READING.
    (o'qishni to'xtatdik)

  REMEMBER:
  + TO = unutma (kelajakdagi ish)
    Remember TO BUY milk.
    (sut olishni unutma)
  + -ING = eslayman (o'tgan ish)
    I remember GIVING you the key.
    (kalit berganimni eslayman)

  FORGET:
  + TO = unutdi (qilmadi)
    She forgot TO PAY the bill.
    (to'lashni unutdi)
  + -ING = hech unutmayman
    (qilganimni)
    I'll never forget LEARNING to
    ride a bicycle.

  ⚠ QOIDA: TO = kelajak/keyin;
  -ING = o'tmish/oldin.


JADVAL:

  TO-INFINITIV: decide, want,
    would like/love, begin, refuse,
    agree, expect sb
  TO SIZ: make, let, can, could,
    will, would, may, must
  -ING: love, like, hate, enjoy,
    don't mind, couldn't help,
    can't stand, look forward to
  IKKALASI: stop, remember, forget

points.en: I stopped to have a cup of coffee. (stop briefly to do something else) — We stopped reading when the bell rang. (finish, give up)
points.uz: Qahva ichish uchun to'xtadim. — O'qishni to'xtatdik. (stop + to / -ing)

points.en: Please remember to buy some milk. (not forget) — I remember giving you the key before I left. (bring to your mind)
points.uz: Sut sotib olishni unutma. — Senga kalit berganimni eslayman. (remember + to / -ing)

points.en: She forgot to pay the phone bill. (not remember) — I'll never forget learning how to ride a bicycle. (always remember)
points.uz: U telefon to'lovini to'lashni unutdi. — Velosiped o'rganganimni hech unutmayman. (forget + to / -ing)

points.en: to-infinitive: decide, want, would like, would love, begin, refuse, agree, expect sb
infinitive without to: make, let, can, could, will, would, may, must
-ing form: love, like, hate, enjoy, don't mind, couldn't help, can't stand, look forward to

patterns.formula: KIM + want / decide / would like + to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: He wanted to buy some sugar. I would like to have a sandwich.
patterns.exampleUz: U shakar sotib olmoqchi edi. Men sendvich yemoqchiman.

patterns.formula: KIM + make / let + KIM + FE'L (to siz)
patterns.exampleEn: My mother made me clean my room. My father lets me use his computer.
patterns.exampleUz: Onam meni xonamni tozalashga majbur qildi. Otam kompyuteridan foydalanishga ruxsat beradi.

patterns.formula: KIM + like / enjoy / don't mind + FE'L-ing
patterns.exampleEn: Tom likes playing basketball. I don't mind going shopping.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom basketbol o'ynashni yoqtiradi. Xaridga borishga qarshi emasman.

patterns.formula: stop / remember / forget + to FE'L (keyingi ish) / + FE'L-ing (oldingi ish)
patterns.exampleEn: Remember to buy some milk. I remember giving you the key.
patterns.exampleUz: Sut olishni unutma. Senga kalit berganimni eslayman.
